title: The unprinted year, ii
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Two months in. The balloons are empty. He's stopped lettering — the drawings still have balloons, but nothing in them. The strip is still funny; you can tell from the faces.

panels.composition: Gully's. GULLY talking, animated, ladle up. WOOD on the stool. Balloons over both of them: EMPTY.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, loose, a man in an apron talking animatedly with a ladle raised and a thin young man answering on a stool, speech balloons drawn over both but completely empty
image.notes: The balloons are drawn and empty. Do not letter them. The faces carry the gag.

panels.composition: Gully's punchline. A big balloon. Empty. His face: delighted with himself.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, loose, a man in an apron delivering a punchline with a large empty speech balloon, his face delighted

panels.composition: Wood's reply. A small balloon. Empty. His face: the face he makes when Gully is right.

characters.pose: the face for when Gully is right

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, loose, a thin young man with a small empty speech balloon and an expression of grudging concession

panels.composition: Both laughing. No balloons. The dog looking up at the noise. Whatever it was, it was good.
panels.caption: Box 5.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, loose, two young men laughing at a shack counter with a dog looking up at them, no speech balloons
image.notes: No lettering anywhere but the caption.

art.line: brush-pen, loose; balloons drawn and left empty; no reader

notes: Empty balloons. The gag survives in the faces. 'Box 5.'
